proof_body:
by
  intro z w hz hw
  constructor
  · have h := Complex.arg_mul_coe_angle hz hw
    rw [← Real.Angle.coe_add, Real.Angle.angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub] at h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
    exact ⟨k, by linarith⟩
  · have h := Complex.arg_div_coe_angle hz hw
    rw [← Real.Angle.coe_sub, Real.Angle.angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub] at h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
    exact ⟨k, by linarith⟩
target_source: ∀ z w : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → w ≠ 0 → (∃ k : ℤ, Complex.arg (z * w) = Complex.arg z + Complex.arg w + 2 * k * Real.pi) ∧ (∃ k : ℤ, Complex.arg (z / w) = Complex.arg z - Complex.arg w + 2 * k * Real.pi)
